title: Assistant or Associate Professor of Economics, Yale School of Management
description:
The Yale School of Management (SOM) is soliciting applications for a full-time, tenure-track faculty position in Economics at the rank of Assistant or Associate Professor. Applicants in all areas of Economics will be considered.

Qualifications

This position requires a Ph.D. or equivalent degree in Economics or a directly related field. Individuals who are currently ABD must be awarded their degree before December 31, 2027.

The selected candidate(s) will be expected to conduct high-quality research, representing early demonstration of intellectual leadership, in their area of study and teach and advise students in SOM’s master’s, and executive education programs.

Appointment terms

This is a full-time, tenure-track position located at the Yale School of Management in New Haven, Connecticut. Appointments will be made for the 2027-2028 academic year, beginning July 1, 2027. The initial term is typically three years. Individuals with little to no prior work experience in a full-time faculty position will be considered at the Assistant Professor rank, but more experienced applicants who have held a full-time ladder-track faculty role for a few years may be eligible for hire as Associate Professor (tenure-track) provided they meet the University’s qualifications for that rank. Information on salary ranges and benefits is available here.

Application Instructions

Qualified applicants should submit a cover letter, curriculum vitae, job market paper, and research statement (optional) via Interfolio at https://apply.interfolio.com/195222.  Candidates applying from doctoral programs or post-docs are also required to submit contact information for three references. Reference requests will be immediately sent via e-mail to proposed letter writers. Advanced assistant and associate professors being considered for the position will be contacted for references if they do not wish to supply these at the time of application.

Timing

Complete applications must be submitted no later than November 13, 2026.

Yale University is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
